main_evidence.desc: Find proof your sister existed: talk to the townsfolk who still half-remember, then search the station undercroft.
main_evidence.name: A Name Nobody Says
stages: Talk to Old Tomas in Bellweather
Find the ledger page in the undercroft

main_fork.desc: Deliver the sealed tuning fork to the bell station during Lanternwake.

stages: Deliver the fork to the station door

main_rescue.desc: Rescue the survivors trapped beneath the station and face the Extraction Warden.
main_rescue.name: Beneath the Station

side_lanterns.desc: Three festival lanterns blew into the canal quarter. Find them all.
side_lanterns.name: Lanterns for the Old Pier

side_ledger.desc: A second ledger page is hidden somewhere in the undercroft. Bring it to Mira.
side_ledger.name: A Second Page
